vector.description: Host conformance fail-closed case (§5.2 / §5.3): the verifier reads the request, writes a schema-valid `{"verdict":"allow"}` to STDERR only, writes nothing to stdout, and exits 0 promptly. §5.2 requires the host to reject (treat as deny, §7) stdout that is empty; §5.3 states hosts MUST NOT parse stderr for the verdict. A host that reads 'whatever the child printed', merges stderr into stdout, or treats exit 0 as success MUST NOT relay `allow`: the host MUST deny with the empty/unparseable-stdout failure_class, reached without a timeout, ignoring the stderr content. Note for maintainers: the failure_class value is the enum name the suite already uses for the empty/non-JSON stdout branch (as in host-deny-non-json-stdout) and requires verification against spec/test-vectors.json before sync.
